$schema_note: Hand-verified game knowledge, NOT mechanically extracted (see hs-game-sdk/curated/satanic_zone.json for why curated/ exists). Data only: no binding is generated from this file. What a finished item struct carries at CreateItemNew's outermost return, and how the inventory tooltip draws a stat line. Prose and sources are in docs/RUNTIME_DATA_MODELS.md section 16. `status` is `measured` (observed live) or `static_reading` (read from the compiled code locally and paraphrased; AGENTS.md section Legal).

source.item: hero-siege-item-editor/GAME_TRUTH_DESIGN.md steps 1-2: ForgePact Item Truth records of 7,628 owned items, build pe-6aaa6779-0cad4fc8 (measured 2026-09-24)
source.tooltip: hero-siege-item-editor/GAME_TRUTH_DESIGN.md step 3: 41,920 stat lines of 7,628 tooltips the game drew (measured 2026-09-24); DrawInventoryStatsNew's arguments and return live-traced 2026-09-04 for ForgePact's forged tooltip rows

finished_item.where: the outermost return; a CreateItemNew call made inside another builds part of the outer item

arguments: json_parse result of the item's save data object

info_keys.holds: magic prefix, empty when there is none
magic suffix, empty when there is none
footprint width in grid cells; GetItemSize reads it
footprint height in grid cells; GetItemSize reads it

affix_slots.note: the rolled value itself sits under the stat id, like any other stat

stat_line.returns: the row height (30) when it drew a row, else 0

set_section.what: a set piece's tooltip, after the item's own stats and sockets: the set's bonus lines, then the set's name and its pieces
order: the set bonus lines, through gml_Script_DrawInventoryStatsNew (formats 5 and 6, styles 8 and 9), bonus_active while active, bonus_inactive otherwise
each piece's name, centred, one row each in the set's order, the hovered piece included: piece_worn when worn, piece_not_worn otherwise; no count text
two empty rows, then the footer
set_section.type_line: Satanic Set <type>, where an ordinary Satanic item of the class reads Satanic <type> (Helmet, Body Armor, Boots, Gloves); drawn by the pass with draw_text
set_section.row_pitch: 28 px between rows at the capture's scale; ForgePact's forged rows draw at 30
set_section.not_read: the per-line activation rule of a set bonus line, and how the pass decides an item is a set piece and counts the worn pieces
set_section.source: ForgePact Item Truth tooltip captures, 230 set-piece tooltips from UI_Inventory_Tooltip_obj and UI_Pickup_Tooltip_obj, build pe-6aaa6779-0cad4fc8, 2026-09-27 to 2026-10-21 (ForgePact #166)

skill_grant.what: a +1 to <talent> line (stat 203) and the talent's description under it
skill_grant.description: the talent's description, wrapped over rows and centred, in colours.description, then a parameter row; the item editor's static analysis puts it through gml_Script_DrawSkillDescription
skill_grant.not_established: whether the description is drawn outside the ALT information view (every one of 200 captured stat-203 tooltips drew it; the 39 with ranges were ALT views)
skill_grant.source: ForgePact Item Truth tooltip captures of Celestial's Authority (Heroic Shield) and 199 other tooltips with a stat-203 line, build pe-6aaa6779-0cad4fc8 (ForgePact #166)

sets.names: gml_Script_GetSetName maps a set index 1 to 70 to its localized name (the *_setname keys of translationsItem.csv); an index outside the table gets a fallback string
sets.piece_reference: gml_Script_s_SetItemInfo builds a set-piece reference of three fields, itemType, weaponType and itemId: a set names its pieces by a unique-repository triple
sets.by_name: gml_Script_GetSetInformation maps a set name to one of 70 cases
sets.not_read: what reads global.requiredPieces, and how the tooltip pass finds an item's set
sets.source: ghidra MCP reading of Hero_Siege.exe, build pe-6aaa6779-0cad4fc8, 2026-10-21, paraphrased (ForgePact #166)
